mapper.sql: id, order_no, title, channel, customer, customer_account, contact, amount, owner_id, status, priority, deadline, requirement, attachments, unread, paid, received_amount, assign_state, revisions, version, create_time, update_time

id, order_no, title, channel, customer, customer_account, contact, amount, owner_id, status, priority, deadline, unread, paid, received_amount, assign_state, revisions, version, create_time, update_time, del_flag, delete_time, delete_by, delete_by_id
mapper.select: select from jiedan_order where del_flag = 0 order by id desc
select from jiedan_order where customer_account = #{customerAccount} and del_flag = 0 order by id desc

select o.id as id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.title as title, o.channel as channel, o.customer as customer, o.customer_account as customerAccount, o.amount as amount, o.owner_id as ownerId, o.status as status, o.priority as priority, o.deadline as deadline, o.requirement as requirement, o.paid as paid, o.revisions as revisions, o.version as version, o.create_time as createTime, o.update_time as updateTime, coalesce(mc.message_count, 0) as messageCount, lt.user_name as lastMessageUser, lt.type as lastMessageType, lt.content as lastMessageContent, case when lt.attachments is null or lt.attachments = '' or lt.attachments = '[]' then 0 else 1 end as lastMessageHasAttachments, lt.create_time as lastMessageTime from jiedan_order o left join ( select t.order_id, count(*) as message_count, max(t.id) as last_id from jiedan_timeline t join jiedan_order co on co.id = t.order_id where co.customer_account = #{customerAccount} and t.type in ('message', 'reply') group by t.order_id ) mc on mc.order_id = o.id left join jiedan_timeline lt on lt.id = mc.last_id where o.customer_account = #{customerAccount} and o.del_flag = 0 order by o.id desc
select version from jiedan_order where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0
select version from jiedan_order where id = #{id} and customer_account = #{customerAccount} and del_flag = 0
select from jiedan_order where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0

select o.id as id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.title as title, o.customer as customer, o.customer_account as customerAccount, o.owner_id as ownerId, o.status as status, o.amount as amount, o.deadline as deadline, o.create_time as createTime, o.delete_time as deleteTime, o.delete_by as deleteBy, o.delete_by_id as deleteById from jiedan_order o where o.del_flag = 1 and o.owner_id = #{ownerId} order by o.delete_time desc, o.id desc
select concat(count(*), '-', coalesce(sum(version), 0), '-', coalesce(max(id), 0)) from jiedan_order where del_flag = 0 and owner_id = #{ownerId}
select id, notes, note_attachments from jiedan_order where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into jiedan_order (order_no, title, channel, customer, customer_account, contact, amount, owner_id, status, priority, deadline, requirement, attachments, unread, paid, received_amount, assign_state, revisions, create_time, update_time) values (#{orderNo}, #{title}, #{channel}, #{customer}, #{customerAccount}, #{contact}, #{amount}, #{ownerId}, #{status}, #{priority}, #{deadline}, #{requirement}, #{attachments}, #{unread}, #{paid}, #{receivedAmount}, #{assignState}, #{revisions}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})
mapper.update: update jiedan_order set attachments = #{attachments} where id = #{id}
update jiedan_order set note_attachments = #{attachments} where id = #{id}
update jiedan_order set del_flag = 1, delete_time = #{time}, delete_by = #{by}, delete_by_id = #{byId}, update_time = #{time}, version = version + 1 where id = #{id} and del_flag = 0

update jiedan_order set del_flag = 0, delete_time = null, delete_by = null, delete_by_id = null, update_time = #{time}, version = version + 1 , owner_id = #{newOwnerId}, assign_state = '' where id = #{id} and del_flag = 1
